definitions.explanation: A window in the ceiling or roof to let in natural light from above.

examples.japanese: {天窓|てんまど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいる→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: Light is streaming in through the skylight.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天窓|てんまど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧。
examples.english: This room is bright because it has a skylight.

examples.japanese: {天窓|てんまど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the stars through the skylight.

notes:
{天窓|てんまど} is a window installed in the ceiling or roof, designed to let natural light in from above. The kanji break down as ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧ (sky/heaven) + ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧ (window). Also called ⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧ (toplight) in architecture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天窓|てんまど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a skylight
- {天窓|てんまど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: light comes in from the skylight
- {天窓|てんまど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a skylight
- {天窓|てんまど}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: to see stars through the skylight

BENEFITS:
Skylights are valued for bringing in {自然光|しぜんこう} (natural light) and improving ⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧ (ventilation) in rooms without many wall windows.

RELATED WINDOW TYPES:
- ⟦{出窓|でまど}→出窓：07067_demado⟧: bay window
- {明|あ}かり{取|と}り: light well/window designed for light
